details.detail: Aisle vault arch, 2-frame panel pitch and continuous joint arcs: correct, and they read as the 777 Signature vault. There is a gradient now, but it is too shallow: the vault-to-band ratio is 0.96 next to the grille and 0.86 at the crease, against 0.83 and 0.58 in c119. The vault therefore reads as part of the light field instead of a shaded surface beyond it. The joints are thin cool-grey lines. In c119 and room37 they are raised light ribs (a highlight plus a shadow).

Cove band and slotted grille: the grille has the right look, with dark fore-aft slots, light frames and bridges on the panel joints. The band is the brightest surface. Seen from the aisle, though, the band is only 1.0-1.4x the grille width (v6 row 150: about 42 px of band against about 30 px of grille; v1 row 100: about 30 against about 33). In c119 it is about 2x (y100 120 px against 60; y200 84 against 48), and in rb_omaat_room37 about 3x. The band also renders in two tones, 247 on its outer part and 238 next to the grille.

Vault fittings: the rounded-rect speaker and the small lens are on every panel, as in c119. The speaker's grey perforated insert is more contrasty than in the photos, where it reads mostly as an outline (cove_pair5 top against bottom).

Outboard bins: correct 2-frame modules, one stadium latch, light seams and a top rail. The door's lower lip reads as a heavy rounded rod (v4top), and under it a near-black 10 px strip (lipGap, 20-23 luminance) runs between the lip and the PSU band, followed by a 10 px grey strip (134). In the real photos the door-to-band junction is a thin mid-grey shadow line (lipL crops from c119 and room37; c26 top).

Centre bins: the shape, the 0.48 m channel and the dark edge lines match y_47300. The door has some gradient seen from below (v6) but is flat grey at about 190 in v5. The channel at 0.87 of the door is close to y_47300's 0.76.

Outboard PSU band: FIXED wells. The dished stadiums are band-coloured and the eyeball and gasper pairs run across the band, as in rb_omaat_room23 and c26. The sign pills are transverse, with amber and red icons. Still missing are the proud, shingle-stepped modules with shadow gaps that c26 and room23 show clearly: the model's band is one flat plate with hairline joints.
Centre PSUs: the light-well and gasper-well rows and the long smoked sign pill are positioned plausibly (v5). The channel is flat, with no stepped transverse panels.
EXIT signs: the light box reads '← 非常口 EXIT →' at the zone ends (v3, v7, v10). The text, aspect and placement are right.
Door-area and monument ceilings: the dome with a downlight, the light strip and the closure over the bin ends are clean in v3, with no sky leaks. They are still unverified against a photo.

Artefacts: no z-fighting, sky leaks or blue hairlines in any r5v view. In the studio slice (f_cbin) the grille reads as a black-and-white zebra, but that comes from studio lighting only: in the cabin it is mid-grey.
